recentItems.title: Cupertino: Official Trailer | CBS
recentItems.description:
Big tech can’t bring them down. From the creators of THE GOOD WIFE, EVIL, and ELSBETH, new series CUPERTINO is a David vs. Goliath legal drama set in the heart of Silicon Valley. Series premiere Thursday, October 8 on CBS and Paramount+.

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #CupertinoCBS
Follow Cupertino on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/cupertinocbs
Like Cupertino on Facebook HERE: https://www.facebook.com/cupertinocbs

CUPERTINO is a David vs. Goliath legal drama set in the heart of Silicon Valley. A lawyer (Mike Colter) is cheated out of his stock options by his former employer, a tech start-up. Refusing to back down, he joins forces with another recently fired attorney (Rachel Keller) to represent those taken advantage of by the tech elite and help them fight back in a high-stakes battle against the Goliaths controlling Silicon Valley.

recentItems.description:
Sheriff Mickey Fox must navigate complicated family dynamics while protecting the town she calls home. Watch the official trailer for Season 2 of #SheriffCountry, premiering Friday, October 9 on CBS and streaming on Paramount+.

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #SheriffCountry
Follow Sheriff Country on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/firesheriffcbs
Follow Sheriff Country on TikTok HERE: https://www.tiktok.com/@firesheriffcbs
Like Sheriff Country on Facebook HERE: https://www.facebook.com/FireCountryCBS
Watch more Sheriff Country HERE: https://www.paramountplus.com/shows/sheriff-country

Morena Baccarin stars as straight-shooting sheriff Mickey Fox, the stepsister of Cal Fire’s division chief Sharon Leone (Diane Farr of Fire Country). She investigates criminal activity while she patrols the streets of small-town Edgewater, contending with her ex-con father, Wes (W. Earl Brown), who is an off-the-grid marijuana grower, and a mysterious incident involving her wayward daughter. Sheriff Country is an expansion of the universe of the hit drama series Fire Country.
